name: Sinopec Group (China Petrochemical Corporation)
desc: State-owned parent of China's largest oil products supplier, spanning exploration, refining, chemicals, fuel retail, lubricants and new energy.
products: Refined fuels, gas stations, lubricants (Great Wall), LPG, petrochemicals, natural gas, hydrogen
customers: Chinese motorists and fleets, industrial and petrochemical buyers, international trading partners
marketing_autonomy_basis: Group exercises investor rights over subsidiaries including listed Sinopec Corp
parent_backing: Registered capital CNY 326.5bn, state assets mandate (sinopecgroup.com profile)
markets: China nationwide fuel retail and refining; international trading, E&P and engineering abroad incl. Central Asia and Africa

signals.what: First export of refined oil products to Kyrgyzstan (300 tonnes diesel), 28 July 2026
Signed procurement agreements with 37 partners from 18 countries worth USD 41.3bn at 9th CIIE

fit_rationale: World's largest refiner and second-largest gas-station network with a lubricants arm; Chinese Grand Prix and global trading/E&P footprint give a home-market and international B2B platform.
category_conflict: potential: fuel and lubricant partners Shell (Ferrari), Petronas (Mercedes), Aramco (Aston Martin), ExxonMobil (Red Bull), BP/Castrol (Audi), Gulf (Williams)
f1_markets: China; plus Middle East and Central Asia markets (Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Azerbaijan)

access.roles: Chairman; brand/corporate culture department; Sinopec Lubricant Company leadership

compliance: State-owned Chinese group; check sanctions exposure of any counterparties
outstanding: Brand 'Sinopec' is shared with the Hong Kong/Shanghai/NY-listed subsidiary China Petroleum & Chemical Corp (Sinopec Corp); user may treat the brand as listed. Group revenue taken from Fortune, not the group annual report.
